answer_text:
Since \(b\) satisfies its minimal polynomial over \(\mathbb{F}_5\),

\[
b^2+b+2=0,
\]

we have

\[
b^2=-b-2.
\]

Thus

\[
b^2+2b=(-b-2)+2b=b-2.
\]

In \(\mathbb{F}_5\), \(-2=3\), so

\[
b^2+2b=b+3.
\]

If \(b+3\in\mathbb{F}_5\), then \(b\in\mathbb{F}_5\), which is impossible because the minimal polynomial of \(b\) over \(\mathbb{F}_5\) has degree \(2\). Therefore

\[
\mathbb{F}_5(b^2+2b)=\mathbb{F}_5(b+3)=\mathbb{F}_5(b)=\mathbb{F}_{25}.
\]

Hence the field has \(25\) elements.

\[
\boxed{25}
\]
